parts.zh: W：这真是难以置信。它和我以前玩过的任何电子游戏都不一样
M：我哥哥去年介绍给我的
M：我完全同意。我哥哥还给我介绍了一些视频
W：说实话，玩这个游戏让我产生了进一步了解这个行业的想法
W：我不确定这款电子游戏与现实情况相比有多准确
M: 你说得对。这方面我确实需要多下些功夫

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about?

choices.text: A driving test.
choices.zh: 驾驶考试。

choices.text: A video game.
choices.zh: 电子游戏。

choices.text: Traffic routes.
choices.zh: 交通路线。

choices.text: Cargo logistics.
choices.zh: 货物物流。

items.stem: What does the man say about the driving simulator?

choices.text: He found it instructive and realistic.
choices.zh: 他认为它富有指导意义且逼真。

choices.text: He bought it when touring Europe.
choices.zh: 他在欧洲旅行时买的。

choices.text: He was really drawn to its other versions.
choices.zh: 他确实被它的其他版本所吸引。

choices.text: He introduced it to his brother last year.
choices.zh: 他去年把它介绍给了他的兄弟。

items.stem: What does the woman say she really appreciates?

choices.text: Traveling all over the country.
choices.zh: 在全国各地旅行。

choices.text: Driving from one city to another.
choices.zh: 从一个城市开车到另一个城市。

choices.text: The details in the driving simulator.
choices.zh: 驾驶模拟器中的细节。

choices.text: The key role of the logistics industry.
choices.zh: 物流行业的关键作用。

items.stem: What outcome does the woman expect from the driving simulator?

choices.text: Clearer road signs.
choices.zh: 更清晰的道路标志。

choices.text: More people driving safely.
choices.zh: 更多人安全驾驶。

choices.text: Stricter traffic rules.
choices.zh: 更严格的交通规则。

choices.text: More self-driving trucks on the road.
choices.zh: 路上有更多自动驾驶卡车。

items.stem: What does the man say about his life of being self-employed?

choices.text: It isn't so enjoyable as he expected.
choices.zh: 没有他预期的那么愉快。

choices.text: It isn't so motivating as he believed.
choices.zh: 没有他认为的那么有激励性。

choices.text: It doesn't enable him to earn as much money as he used to.
choices.zh: 无法让他赚到像以前那样多的钱。

choices.text: It doesn't seem to offer as much freedom as he anticipated.
choices.zh: 似乎没有提供他预想的那么多自由。

items.stem: What does the man say about managers?

choices.text: Not all of them care about their employees' behaviors.
choices.zh: 并非所有管理者都关心员工的行为。

choices.text: Few of them are aware of their employees' feelings.
choices.zh: 很少有管理者意识到员工的感受。

choices.text: Few of them offer praise and reward to their employees.
choices.zh: 很少有管理者给予员工表扬和奖励。

choices.text: Not all of them know how to motivate their employees.
choices.zh: 并非所有管理者都知道如何激励员工。

items.stem: What do both speakers value most about self-employment?

choices.text: Job satisfaction.
choices.zh: 工作满意度。

choices.text: Self-awareness.
choices.zh: 自我意识。

choices.text: Autonomy.
choices.zh: 自主权。

choices.text: Money.
choices.zh: 金钱。

items.stem: On what point does the man agree with the woman?

choices.text: The importance of cultivating close relationships with clients.
choices.zh: 与客户培养密切关系的重要性。

choices.text: The need for getting recommendations from their managers.
choices.zh: 需要从管理者那里获得推荐。

choices.text: The advantages of permanent full-time employment.
choices.zh: 永久全职工作的优势。

choices.text: The way to explore employees' interests and talents.
choices.zh: 探索员工兴趣和才能的方式。

items.stem: What do we learn about the findings of the new study?

choices.text: Consumers visualize their activities in different weather.
choices.zh: 消费者在不同天气下想象自己的活动。

choices.text: Good weather triggers consumers' desire to go shopping.
choices.zh: 好天气激发消费者的购物欲望。

choices.text: Weather conditions influence consumers' buying behavior.
choices.zh: 天气状况影响消费者的购买行为。

choices.text: Consumers' mental states change with the prices of goods.
choices.zh: 消费者的心理状态随商品价格而变化。

items.stem: What does the passage say may increase the value of products for consumers?

choices.text: Active consumption.
choices.zh: 主动消费。

choices.text: Direct correlation.
choices.zh: 直接相关性。

choices.text: Individual association.
choices.zh: 个人联想。

choices.text: Mental visualization.
choices.zh: 心理想象。

items.stem: How can the findings of the new study benefit online sellers according to the researchers?

choices.text: Enabling them to simplify their mathematical formulas.
choices.zh: 使他们能够简化数学公式。

choices.text: Helping them determine what to sell and at what price.
choices.zh: 帮助他们确定销售什么产品以及以什么价格销售。

choices.text: Enabling them to sell their products at a higher price.
choices.zh: 使他们能够以更高的价格销售产品。

choices.text: Helping them advertise a greater variety of products.
choices.zh: 帮助他们宣传更多种类的产品。

items.stem: What is the accepted wisdom concerning the office environment?

choices.text: A naturally ventilated office is more comfortable.
choices.zh: 自然通风的办公室更加舒适。

choices.text: A cool office will boost employees' productivity.
choices.zh: 凉爽的办公室会提高员工的生产力。

choices.text: Office air-conditioning should follow guidebooks.
choices.zh: 办公室空调应遵循指南手册。

choices.text: Air-conditioning improves ventilation in the office.
choices.zh: 空调改善了办公室的通风。

items.stem: What did researchers find from their review of all studies relating to air-conditioning and productivity?

choices.text: People in their comfort zone of temperature are more satisfied with their productivity.
choices.zh: 处于温度舒适区的人对自己的生产力更满意。

choices.text: People in different countries vary in their tolerance to uncomfortable temperatures.
choices.zh: 不同国家的人对不舒适温度的耐受性各不相同。

choices.text: Twenty-two degrees is the optimal temperature for office workers.
choices.zh: 22度是办公室工作人员的最佳温度。

choices.text: There is a range of temperatures for people to feel comfortable.
choices.zh: 人们感到舒适的温度有一个范围。

items.stem: What do we learn about using a little less air-conditioning during hot weather?

choices.text: It will have no negative impact on work.
choices.zh: 这不会对工作产生负面影响。

choices.text: It will be immediately noticeable.
choices.zh: 这会立即被注意到。

choices.text: It will sharply decrease work efficiency.
choices.zh: 这会大幅降低工作效率。

choices.text: It will cause a lot of discomfort.
choices.zh: 这会造成很多不适。

items.stem: What happens when people are used to an air-conditioned environment?

choices.text: They tend to favor lower temperatures.
choices.zh: 他们倾向于喜欢更低的温度。

choices.text: They suffer from rapid temperature changes.
choices.zh: 他们遭受快速温度变化的困扰。

choices.text: They are not bothered by temperature extremes.
choices.zh: 他们不会被极端温度所困扰。

choices.text: They become less sensitive to high temperatures.
choices.zh: 他们对高温变得不那么敏感。

items.stem: What is one of the criticisms directed at the early research on solitude?

choices.text: It overlooked the possibility that emotions may be controlled.
choices.zh: 它忽视了情绪可能被控制的可能性。

choices.text: It ignored the fact that emotions are personal and subjective.
choices.zh: 它忽略了情绪是个人的和主观的这一事实。

choices.text: It classified emotions simply as either positive or negative.
choices.zh: 它简单地将情绪分为积极或消极两类。

choices.text: It measured positive and negative emotions independently.
choices.zh: 它独立地测量了积极情绪和消极情绪。

items.stem: What do we learn about the results of the new research?

choices.text: Sitting alone without doing anything seemed really distressing.
choices.zh: 独自坐着什么都不做似乎真的令人痛苦。

choices.text: Solitude adversely affected the participants' mental well-being.
choices.zh: 独处对参与者的心理健康产生了不利影响。

choices.text: Sitting alone for 15 minutes made the participants restless.
choices.zh: 独自坐15分钟使参与者感到焦躁不安。

choices.text: Solitude had a reductive effect on high-arousal emotions.
choices.zh: 独处对高唤醒情绪有减弱作用。

items.stem: What did the second experiment in the new research find about solitude?

choices.text: It proved hard to depict objectively.
choices.zh: 事实证明很难客观地描述它。

choices.text: It went hand in hand with sadness.
choices.zh: 它与悲伤相伴而生。

choices.text: It helped increase low-arousal emotions.
choices.zh: 它有助于增加低唤醒情绪。

choices.text: It tended to intensify negative emotions.
choices.zh: 它往往会加剧消极情绪。

items.stem: What do we learn about the brain when the body is at rest?

choices.text: It uses up much less energy than it does in deep thinking.
choices.zh: 它消耗的能量比深度思考时少得多。

choices.text: It remains inactive without burning calories noticeably.
choices.zh: 它保持不活跃状态，不会明显燃烧卡路里。

choices.text: It continues to burn up calories to help us stay in shape.
choices.zh: 它继续燃烧卡路里以帮助我们保持体形。

choices.text: It consumes almost a quarter of the body's total energy.
choices.zh: 它消耗身体总能量的近四分之一。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the consumption of the brain's energy?

choices.text: Much of the consumption has nothing to do with conscious activities.
choices.zh: 大部分消耗与意识活动无关。

choices.text: It has something to do with the difficulty of the activities in question.
choices.zh: 它与相关活动的难度有关。

choices.text: Energy usage devoted to active learning accounts for a big part of it.
choices.zh: 用于主动学习的能量消耗占其中很大一部分。

choices.text: A significant amount of it is for performing difficult cognitive tasks.
choices.zh: 其中相当大的一部分用于执行困难的认知任务。

items.stem: What do we learn about the overall energy availability in the brain?

choices.text: It is believed to remain basically constant.
choices.zh: 它被认为基本保持恒定。

choices.text: It is a prerequisite for any mental activity.
choices.zh: 它是任何心理活动的先决条件。

choices.text: It is conducive to relieving mental exhaustion.
choices.zh: 它有助于缓解精神疲劳。

choices.text: It is thought to be related to food consumption.
choices.zh: 它被认为与食物摄入有关。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the job interview question "tell me about yourself"?

choices.text: Job candidates rarely take it seriously.
choices.zh: 求职者很少认真对待它。

choices.text: Job seekers tend to have a ready answer.
choices.zh: 求职者往往会有一个现成的答案。

choices.text: Job seekers often feel at a loss where to start in answering it.
choices.zh: 求职者在回答时常常感到不知从何说起。

choices.text: Job candidates can respond freely due to its open-ended nature.
choices.zh: 由于其开放性,求职者可以自由作答。

items.stem: What will most people do when they come to a job interview?

choices.text: Follow their career coaches' guidelines.
choices.zh: 遵循职业指导师的指导方针。

choices.text: Strive to take control of their narrative.
choices.zh: 努力掌控自己的叙述。

choices.text: Do their best to impress the interviewer.
choices.zh: 尽最大努力给面试官留下深刻印象。

choices.text: Repeat the information on their resume.
choices.zh: 重复简历上的信息。

items.stem: Why should job seekers talk with partners, friends and co-workers?

choices.text: To reflect on their past achievements as well as failures.
choices.zh: 反思他们过去的成就和失败。

choices.text: To produce examples for different interview questions.
choices.zh: 为不同的面试问题准备例子。

choices.text: To discuss important details they are going to present.
choices.zh: 讨论他们将要呈现的重要细节。

choices.text: To identify a broad general strength to elaborate on.
choices.zh: 确定一个可以详细阐述的宽泛的总体优势。

items.stem: What other important preparations should job seekers make before an interview?

choices.text: Getting acquainted with the human resources personnel.
choices.zh: 结识人力资源人员。

choices.text: Finding out why the company provides the job opening.
choices.zh: 弄清楚公司为什么提供这个职位空缺。

choices.text: Figuring out what benefits the company is able to offer them.
choices.zh: 弄清楚公司能够为他们提供什么福利。

choices.text: Tailoring their expectations to the company's long-term goal.
choices.zh: 使他们的期望与公司的长期目标相匹配。
